mode.doc: auto: keep the input's result and reuse it while the input is unchanged; off: pass the input through and cache nothing.

cache_any_frame.doc: Keep results for multiple frames. When off, retain only the current frame.

max_frames.doc: Maximum number of frames stored for this Cache node.

clear_on_upstream_change.doc: Clear stored frames when the upstream recipe or parameters change.

clear_cache.doc: Toggle on to clear all stored frames for this node; toggle off to rearm.

clear_current_frame_cache.doc: Toggle on to clear this frame for this node; toggle off to rearm.
